ov: جاسوس (الإنجليزية: Spy) هو فيلم حركة وكوميديا أمريكي صدر في سنة 2015. من إخراج وتأليف بول فيج، ومن بطولة ميليسا مكارثي وجيسون ستاثام وروز بيرن وميراندا هارت وبوبي كانفيل وأليسون جاني وجود لو. صدر الفيلم في 5 يونيو 2015 وتلقى مراجعات إيجابية جداً من النقاد ووصلت إيراداته إلى 118 مليون $.
plotEn:
Susan Cooper is a desk-bound CIA agent who remotely assists her partner, field agent Bradley Fine, whom she has feelings for, on his missions. Fine accidentally kills arms dealer Tihomir Boyanov before Boyanov can tell Fine where a suitcase nuke is hidden.
Susan discovers Boyanov's daughter, Rayna, has contacted terrorist middleman Sergio De Luca, so Fine infiltrates her home. Rayna reveals she knows the identities of the agency's field agents, including Rick Ford and Karen Walker, then kills Fine.
Since Susan has never been in the field and is therefore unknown to Rayna, she volunteers to track Rayna herself and her boss, Elaine Crocker, agrees. Ford objects due to Susan's inexperience and quits in protest.
With her best friend and colleague Nancy providing remote intelligence, Susan travels to Paris. A rogue Ford follows her there, repeatedly interfering in her mission. Susan discovers De Luca's office has been burned down, but finds a photo of a man at the fire. She sees the man from the photo switch Ford's backpack with one containing a bomb. She saves Ford and pursues the man, accidentally killing him. Susan finds proof that De Luca is going to Rome and is sent after him.
Susan's contact there is Italian agent Aldo. Following De Luca into a casino, Susan saves Rayna's life from an assassination attempt.
